name: Free Music Archive Music Analysis Benchmark
description: A benchmark for analyzing music content in the Free Music Archive collection, typically used to evaluate automatic music tagging, genre/mood classification, and related audio understanding tasks.
evaluation_method: Classification metrics such as accuracy, F1 score, mAP, or AUC depending on the label setup.
notes: Exact task definition varies across papers using the Free Music Archive data. Often used as a music information retrieval benchmark rather than a single standardized leaderboard task.
